name: beacons_line_2nodes
note: office floor, straight line from laptop, 3 m spacing, nodes on floor, power banks; node 2 unplugged ~120-150 s
observed: Node 1 (MAC 10:BD:A3:CF:B1:20) went silent ~113-127 s and rebooted (came back at default full TX power); node 2 stayed up the whole run. TXPOWER 8 at ~89 s dropped RSSI ~20 dB; gateway still heard both directly, with occasional hops=1 copies of node 2 relayed via node 1. rx_dropped=0.
